id: HL-07 a closing fence is indented at most 3 columns, and a fence in a blockquote is one (0.1.5 E-3 review round 6)

A closing line is now indented at most 3 columns (or as far as the opening line, for a fence in a list item), and fences are read after `>` markers; a block in a quote ends with the quote.
